messages:
ana: Quick design QA on the 'deepnight' dark theme mock — overall nice but a few practical issues surfaced. Main ones: micro-chart legibility at thumbnail sizes, inline code contrast, and the theme toggle label is confusing in the header. Screenshot: https://screens.mock/deepnight.png :mag:
ben: Saw that. Tiny sparklines and mini bar charts basically lose their series at 10–12px. Proposal: add a thin stroke to primary lines (1px) and increase line luminance by ~12% for thumbnails.
vika: Code blocks are nearly identical to the panel bg so inline `curl` examples vanish. Propose code-bg: #0d1a28 and code-text: #eaf8ff, padding 12px. That hits AA at small sizes in local checks.
tom: On copy: the header toggle currently says "Night" / "Day" which some teammates found ambiguous. Suggest using icon-only toggle with an accessible label "Dark theme" and include a separate control in Settings -> Accessibility called "Reduce motion & low-power".
ana: (typo fix) ana: also noticed token chips in the metrics panel lack visual hierarchy — the active month looks identical to historical months. Make the active chip outlined and slightly brighter.
ben: For charts I experimented with gradient midpoint at 33% instead of 50% and desaturated area fills by 8%. Results: midtones read much clearer without washing out peaks. We should also avoid full linear gradients on stacked areas — use subtle banding + faint stroke to preserve separation.
vika: CSS var suggestion to try in the branch:
--panel-950: #03050a
--panel-850: #0b1a2a
--code-bg: #0d1a28
--code-text: #eaf8ff
--accent-primary: #58d9ff
--accent-secondary: #a27bff
(I ran the axis label contrast at 13px; primary combos pass 4.5:1.)
ben: Also legend dots: at 9–11px they disappear. Increase the dot stroke to 1px and bump fill luminance +10%. Tiny but helps a lot in thumbnails.
tom: UX copy tweak: Tokens panel title reads "Token usage by route" — can we change to "Token usage — by route" (em dash) for scannability? And move the theme helper text out of the header into Settings where we can explain "Reduced motion / low-power" separately.
design-bot: Created branch theme/deepnight-contrast and opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/944 (deepnight: chart strokes, code contrast, tiny copy tweaks). Storybook added. CI: visual snapshots flagged for two chart variants.
vika: Accessibility request: add an opt-in "High-contrast charts" toggle under Settings -> Accessibility (default off). This makes customer demos & internal testing easier without changing default aesthetics.
ben: I'll prototype the stroke + midpoint changes in Storybook and run a visual diff. If diffs are small we can A/B to staging.
nana: Action items: ben to push story + run diffs; vika to update code CSS & spacing; tom to update header toggle to icon-only + move helper copy; ana to run a full contrast audit after PR lands. Target: staging tomorrow. :calendar:
ben: I'll try to push before EOD. :rocket:
